notes.title: Demo v0.4.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
✨ Improvements
Mouse wheel zooming is now centered around the mouse cursor instead of the center of the screen, so you can point-and-zoom and it will magnify the area where you are pointing.

Magnify and pan gestures are now supported (e.g. from a MacBook trackpad).
🪲 Bug Fixes
Demolish Everything button is no longer clickable while it is hidden (the keyboard shortcut continues to works regardless of the button visibility).

When going to the settings menu or main menu while Demolish mode is active, the cursor now changes back from the demolish cursor to the regular mouse cursor.
🛠️ Internal Changes
The game engine has been upgraded to Godot 4.4.1, bringing some upstream performance improvements and bug fixes.

notes.title: Demo v0.4.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
✨ Improvements
The number of daily delivered parcels is now visible even in Chill Mode.

Cannon and Gravity Well descriptions had their wording updated to better explain what the buildings can and cannot do.

Tutorial has been updated to mention that Freeze buttons also freeze upgrade costs between days.
🪲 Bug Fixes
Font issues on the Steam Deck have been fixed. This involved disabling fallback to system fonts on all platforms, so please let us know if you encounter any other font-rendering issues.

notes.title: Demo v0.4.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
🖼️ Visual Changes
Days now begin and end at noon instead of at midnight -- we have heard your feedback that the lighting and shadows look a lot better during the day and people spend a lot of time in the paused state at the end of one day and the start of another, and of course we would like to present the game in the best light.

Shadow quality was improved, especially on the Arctic Shores biome.

Soft shadow quality can now be configured in the settings.

notes.title: Demo v0.4.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
🪲 Bug Fixes
 ❄️Arctic Shores modifier that makes a building type cheaper (🛷🔨Sledge Hammers) now properly works with other cost-reducing upgrades (sorry, no more free [strike]lunch[/strike] hammers!)

 🛷🔨Sledge Hammers cost reductions are now factored into hammer return previews inside the Shop

notes.title: Demo v0.4.3 Patch Notes – ❄️ Snow biome, Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
Demo v0.4.3 Patch Notes
Now live during Steam Next Fest! 🎉

We've also published a brand new Gameplay Trailer that focuses on the core gameplay loop, check it out, [strike]turtles 🐢[/strike] puffins all the way down.


✨ New Features
❄️ Snow biome now unlockable by beating Grassy Cliffs ⛰️ – includes new modifiers like Sledge Hammers🛷🔨 and Permafrost for diverse gameplay

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565274/befbdcfb13d8c6e56fc57f645d24d5a6d4b47bc0.png"]
🎨 Improvements

Various UI polish and positioning improvements

notes.title: Demo v0.3.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
✨ Improvements
New Cannon upgrade, Ammozone Prime, lets Cannons load parcels directly from neighboring buildings

Each building and upgrade now has a fancy icon and upgrades have an assigned upgrade type

Building names are now color-coded in the shop

Redundant tooltips were removed from the shop
⚖️ Balancing Changes
Higher Cannon base fire rate (0.6 -> 1.0)

Cannon fire rate increase from Fire at Will is stronger (0.1 -> 0.15)

Cannon upgrade Giddy Gunners weaker (80% -> 50%) but cheaper

Higher Gravity Well base pull speed (0.3 -> 0.5)

Cannon and Gravity Well upgrades are now generally cheaper
🪲 Bug Fixes
Some path finding fixes and optimizations, slight efficiency improvements when multiple parallel parcel paths exist

notes.title: Demo v0.3.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
🪲 Bug Fixes

 Fixed keyboard focus changing abruptly shortly after buying a shop upgrade.

notes.title: Demo v0.3.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
✨ Improvements

 Enhanced the shop with smoother animations and additional sound effects
 Added helpful tooltips to top-level UI elements (stamp & hammer counters, parcel progress bars)
 New option to show FPS available in Interface Settings for performance monitoring


🪲 Bug Fixes

 Resolved pathfinding issue that could cause parcels to take suboptimal delivery routes even if it was not efficient

notes.title: 📮 Puffin Parcel Post Demo is NOW LIVE! Meet the devs May 23rd.
notes.content:
📯 Special delivery confirmed!

The wait is over! The Puffin Parcel Post demo has officially landed on Steam and is ready for you to play right now!

If you happen to be in Prague, drop by tonight – Friday, May 23rd – to chat with the devs at Indie Game Night in Prague.

🎮 Your Postal Empire Awaits

Jump in and start building your dream postal network! Place buildings strategically, manage deliveries, and watch your adorable puffin workforce zip across the map with important parcels. The demo gives you everything you need to get a taste of running your own feathered postal service.

💬 We Want to Hear From You!

After you've had a chance to play, we'd love your feedback! You can share your thoughts:

 Through the in-game feedback system
 On our Discord server where our dev team is active daily
 Right here in the Steam community discussions


Your input helps us make the full game even better, so don't be shy about letting us know what you think!

🚀 Ready to Get Started?

Hit that download button and let your puffins get to work! We can't wait to see what postal empires you'll create.

Happy building!
The Puffin Parcel Post Team

[hr][/hr]

P.S. Enjoying the demo? A wishlist would help our puffins deliver this game to even more future postmasters!

We would also be very grateful for any reviews which you can write specifically on the Demo page after you've played for a while.

notes.title: 📮 Puffin Parcel Post Demo Lands on May 20!
notes.content:
📯Dear future postmaster,

We're thrilled to welcome you to our very first Steam community post for Puffin Parcel Post! Our team has been stamping away at development, and we're excited to share some special delivery news with you.

🎮 Special Delivery: Demo Arrives May 20th!

Mark your calendars! Our free demo will be landing in your Steam library on May 20th. You'll finally get your chance to build a postal empire where puffins handle the heavy lifting! Place buildings strategically, manage deliveries, and watch as your feathered workforce zips across the map with important parcels.
In the demo, you'll get to:

 Build and optimize your own postal network from scratch
 Unlock perks and upgrades that'll change how you play
 Tackle delivery challenges in our first environment
 Meet our hardworking puffin postal team (no stamps required!)


📺 First-Class Preview: Demo Announcement Trailer

Want a sneak peek at your future postal empire? In case you haven't seen it yet, check it out on YouTube and share it with friends who might enjoy joining our postal service!

[previewyoutube=4qW8Mwq89PU;full][/previewyoutube]

🔍 Can't Wait for Delivery? Join Our Discord!

Too excited to wait until May 20th? We get it! Join our Discord server where we sometimes look for playtesters. Our most active community members might find themselves sorting parcels earlier than expected... 🔑📦

Our Discord is where all the behind-the-scenes action happens:

 Regular development updates with fresh screenshots and videos
 Direct line to our development team
 A place to share your feedback and suggestions
 And occasional special surprises (no postage due!)


Join the Puffin Postal Service Discord!

Thanks for your interest in Puffin Parcel Post! We can't wait to see what you'll build. Keep an eye on this mailbox for more updates as we approach the demo release! 📭

Yours sincerely,
The Puffin Parcel Post Team

[hr][/hr] 

P.S. If you haven't already, please wishlist our game! Every wishlist helps our puffins deliver this game to more addresses!
